name: Rook
greeting: Solid. There goes my last excuse for losing.
lines: Rook: Stones. And no. I'm trying honesty. It leaves a man terribly exposed.
Kael: At least he'll stay seated.

actions.label: Save me a place at the table.

relationship_event.text: Kael and Rook repaired the stool and agreed to share the common table again.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: Your seat's still there. I haven't wagered it. Yet.
